summary: Verified overtime grace-period fix works correctly per spec. However, discovered CRITICAL bug: admin approve/reject endpoint returns HTTP 500 because DutyApprovalUpdate model in routes_new_features.py is missing fields the handler tries to access.
passed: 15-min OT (equals grace) -> OT=0 (correct, must EXCEED grace)
16-min OT (>grace) -> OT=30 rounded up to nearest 15 (correct)
Details mandatory when OT>0 -> 400 'Details are mandatory when overtime is worked'

GET /api/payroll/{driver}/2026/11 returns all fields: base_salary, total_overtime_amount, total_conveyance, total_dinner, total_breakfast, total_bonuses, total_expenses, total_advances, leave_deductions, loan_deductions
Frontend loads, admin login redirects to /admin, Duty Approvals page renders 5 pending entries with Approve/Reject buttons

failed.issue: PUT /api/duty-entries/{id}/approve returns 500 Internal Server Error. Backend log: AttributeError: 'DutyApprovalUpdate' object has no attribute 'overtime_minutes'. The DutyApprovalUpdate model defined in /app/backend/routes_new_features.py (line 87-88) only declares 'approval_status', but the approve_duty_entry handler (lines 323-328) accesses approval.overtime_minutes, approval.admin_remarks, and approval.remark_text. A complete DutyApprovalUpdate model with these fields already exists in server.py (line 167-171) but is not being used here.
failed.evidence: curl PUT /api/duty-entries/<id>/approve -> HTTP 500. Frontend toast: 'Failed to update approval status'. Traceback in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log at routes_new_features.py:323.

action_items: Fix /app/backend/routes_new_features.py: extend the local DutyApprovalUpdate model (line 87) to include: overtime_minutes: Optional[int]=None, admin_remarks: Optional[str]=None, remark_text: Optional[str]=None. Or import the full model from server.py instead of redefining. This unblocks the entire admin approval/reject flow (Approve button, Reject button, Edit-then-approve, and bulk Select-All approve).
notes: Overtime grace-period fix in calculate_duty_details is fully verified and working correctly. The approve endpoint bug is a regression (or pre-existing bug not caught previously) that blocks the primary admin workflow.
